title: SUNSEA
description: sunsea.co.th Sunsea Plastics P.S. Co., Ltd. is a family-owned Thai polyethylene film manufacturer founded in 1988, operating a purpose-built 13,000 sq.m factory in Bangna, Bangkok (office at Soi Lasalle 24, Sukhumvit Rd). It is Thailand's leading independent PE extruder, producing LDPE shrink film (rolls, hoods, sleeves, bags), LLDPE lamination and printing films, mLLDPE, PP/PE coex films, milk pouches and overwrap films, running 16 mono-layer plus 3-layer lines. It is the sole ExxonMobil-authorized producer of Nexxstar collation shrink film in Thailand and is ISO 9001 certified
